text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after our meeting.
I decided to offer her some treats we received from a clan relative the other day while she took a break.
choice_data_list: 頂き物のおかきと玄米茶です
choice_data_list_en: It's a gift of rice crackers and brown rice tea.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you.
choice_data_list: 僭越ながら、私もご相伴にあずかります
choice_data_list_en: If I may be so bold, I shall partake as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I see. Please, make yourself comfortable.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Yet, how rare.
For an offer like that to come from you.
choice_data_list: 申し訳ありません、図々しくも……
choice_data_list_en: I'm so sorry, how brazen of me...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No, on the contrary, I would welcome it.
As much as you'd like...———

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (There are an awful lot of spicy dishes on his plate...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (There are an awful lot of spicy dishes on her plate...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ――Heh. Such exquisite attention to detail.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Was that not long after we had first
entered into our contract, I wonder—)

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Today's primo piatto—
Arrabbiata.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
choice_data_list: すみません、ドリンクのおかわりを……
choice_data_list_en: Excuse me, could I get a refill on my drink...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
("I would like a coconut milk"—
Having placed that order, the Trainer
casually asked if I might care for one as well.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(I recall quite vividly how
utterly astonished I was by that conduct.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (However, after the meal, you————)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Do not look so disheartened, Trainer.
The fault lies with me for keeping it from you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...You said you can't handle spicy food?
choice_data_list: いえ、しかし……これまでも――
choice_data_list_en: No, but... even up until now—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(He felt terribly remorseful that among the meals he arranged for me every day,
a few had been seasoned too spicy.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(She felt terribly remorseful that among the meals she arranged for me every day,
a few had been seasoned too spicy.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (Unable to bear the sight, I————)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Truly, there is no need to trouble yourself over it.
By nature, my position does not permit me to show likes or dislikes.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why I trained so fiercely.
Ever since childhood—

text_block_list.name: Young Rose
text_block_list.text: “Uuu... my mouth is burning...”

text_block_list.name: Personal Chef
text_block_list.text:
“You have already managed half of the dish,
perhaps we should call it a day here...?”

text_block_list.name: Young Rose
text_block_list.text:
“No... not yet! I shall finish every last bite!
Chef, bring me milk...!”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And so, I believed I had overcome it...
or so I had thought.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To be noticed so easily by you...
I still have much to learn.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I apologize, but could you keep this matter strictly confidential?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(He has faithfully kept his promise
to keep it 'strictly confidential.' But...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(She has faithfully kept her promise
to keep it 'strictly confidential.' But...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Ever since that day, the meals he
arranges for me have always been...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Ever since that day, the meals she
arranges for me have always been...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Savoring my share of the rice crackers,
I happened to glance up—only to find Rose Kingdom
seemingly lost in thought.
choice_data_list_en: (What could be the matter, I wonder...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to fret so deeply on my account,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I told you, I have overcome it.
It is not as if I cannot eat it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: If this refreshment was offered to me, it is only proper etiquette that I partake of it fully.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From her expression and gaze... I realized she was calling me
out for hoarding all the spicy rice crackers onto my own plate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At the same time... it was pointed out that I have consistently eliminated spicy foods from her meals outside of official occasions. But...
choice_data_list: 私が食べたい味を選ばせて頂いたのです
choice_data_list_en: I was allowed to choose the flavor I wanted to eat.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: You are... perhaps a bit too loyal.
choice_data_list: ローズ様の努力家ぶりには及びません
choice_data_list_en: No, it is presumptuous of me.
It pales in comparison to your hard work, Lady Rose.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
――Heh.
Is that so...? Then I must offer you my thanks.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“Having acquired an 'impudent retainer,'
I have, by mere chance, found my days rather pleasant.”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Nothing could be more fortunate...
Wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is hardly something worthy of being called effort.
If anything, I cannot help but feel I am indulging in your kindness and growing lax...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I have heard that spicy food is, to some extent, a matter of 'getting used to it'...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I think I shall partake in the mildly spicy rice crackers after all.
Trainer, would you mind?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once more, it was a moment that left me
in awe of her relentless work ethic.
